integrity: All construction identities have exact integer-arithmetic checks. Claims of independent validation and originality priority are not made.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-conic five-distinct-line ADE class is treated; no classification of all extremizers. Universal tau-28 exclusion relies on Merta–Zieliński Proposition 3.2; unindexed equivalent examples remain possible.
title: Sharp Tjurina bound and a free extremizer for one-conic five-line ADE arrangements
